answer: Agents secure entry by performing 50,000 recursive hashing steps to generate a valid beacon. A verifier challenges agents to provide this proof at a specific temporal knoll within the protocol, ensuring non-replay. An honest participant spends 50,000 units once, while 1,000 fakes must repeat this for 50,000,000 units. A network inlet captures these proofs to audit sequential consistency. We assume CPU cycles cannot be amortized.
